metadata.notes: One checkpoint for the fork's mg-05 and mg-06 (user, 2026-11-24): the state right after the glitch battle is never saved on the Switch, so the only save after the battle is this one, after the duplication proved the glitch works. A retry starts again from one tile outside Lea's sightline (07-glitch-prep's end), where the battle's luck gets 3 tries as the fork's mg-05 did. The battle (ported from the fork's tested PlanData/mg-05.plan.json, Route 16 run on mGBA, 2026-11-23) steps north into Lea's sightline and ends on (30, 6) facing north with MIMIEN (Lv 33) holding the recycled Leppa Berry; verify_mail_glitch reads MIMIEN's held-item mark, and the Fly from (30, 6) follows. The rest: spec docs/mail-glitch-use.md (PR #52) and the user's decisions there. The fork's mg-05 mGBA save after the battle (Route 16 (30, 6), mail index 0, record 0 = ABRA) had Retro Mail 1, Antidote 2 and $20,788, $1,624 more than 07-glitch-prep's end ($21,464 - $2,300): Lea & Jed's prize. Retro Mail: 1 + 8 - 5 - 1 - 1 = 2. Antidote: 2 - 1 given to MIMIEN + 1 duplicated = 2 in the bag (3 in all). Money: $400 for the mail less the $1,624 prize, $1,224 more than at the start. Dropped from the fork's mg-05 postconditions: slots 1-3's held-item marks (held_item, none, held_item), which the mail given to slots 2-6 changes; the checkpoint checks the marks after (held_item, then five mail) itself.
